name: dev.shopify.common.address_line_components
title: Address Line Components Extension
description: Extends postal addresses on the Checkout and Order capabilities with structured street-line components (`address_line_components`) and an independent `address_code`, for countries whose addresses are written that way. The flat `street_address` and `extended_address` keep their meaning; the components are an additive, structured view of the same two lines.

address_line_components.description: Structured components of the two street lines. `street_name` and `street_number` are the components of `street_address`; `additional_information`, `district` and `subdistrict` are the components of `extended_address`. Which components a country uses is a property of the country, not of this schema; a sender includes the components the destination country writes and omits the rest.

street_name.description: Road or street name. Component of `street_address`.

street_number.description: Building or house number. Component of `street_address`.

additional_information.description: Apartment, suite, unit, building, landmark or other detail that fits no other component. Component of `extended_address`.

district.description: First sub- or super-city division where the country has one, for example a Brazilian bairro, a Mexican colonia or an Indonesian kecamatan. Component of `extended_address`.

subdistrict.description: Second, finer division where the country has one, for example an Indonesian kelurahan. Used together with `district`. Component of `extended_address`.

address_code.description: Country-specific code that identifies the delivery point independently of the street lines, for example the Saudi Additional Number or the UAE Makani number. It is never composed into `street_address` or `extended_address`.

postal_address_properties.description: The properties this extension adds to a postal address. Composed onto every address-bearing location of an extended capability.

postal_address.title: Postal Address with Address Line Components
postal_address.description: A postal address carrying structured street-line components. When a request carries a component of a street line together with the flat line itself, the components win and the business composes the flat line from them; a request that carries only the flat line for a street line carries no components for that line.

shipping_destination.title: Shipping Destination with Address Line Components
shipping_destination.description: A `shipping_address` fulfillment destination carrying structured street-line components. The Checkout composition below adds the same properties to every destination; this named composition is the shape a `shipping_address` destination takes.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Address Line Components
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with address line components on shipping destinations (negotiated through the Fulfillment extension) and on payment-instrument billing addresses.

items.description: A `shipping_address` destination may carry `address_line_components` and `address_code`; a `business_location` destination never does.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Address Line Components
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with address line components on fulfillment expectation destinations.
